'''FC Sioni''' (''[[Georgian language|Georgian]]:'' საფეხბურთო კლუბი სიონი) is a [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]]n professional [[football (soccer)|football]] club based in [[Bolnisi]]. They compete in [[Erovnuli Liga 2|Erovnuli Liga Liga 2]], the second tier of the [[Football in Georgia (country)|Georgian league system]].

The team has won the league title on one occasion, in 2005/06. Sioni play their home matches at local stadium named after [[Tamaz Stepania]]."}}
